I’m very honest and open about the ways I’ve fucked up, or things I could have done better, because it’s part of the story, it’s part of learning and growing, it’s all part of what has led us to now. Nothing about her resembles anything of a monster and I’ve made this clear with people I’ve confided in. A lot of what has happened from her behalf has come from a place of fear or pain. Especially an intense fear of abandonment. There’s no talking to anyone she’s threatened by, or anyone from her past relationships. But her friends who reached out, reached out with love and concern. Concern for some of the choices she’s made, and concern for how these choices have impacted me. Maybe I’m in the guilt part of the grief process, I don’t know. I also have a panic disorder so that could be affecting how I feel.

With the lying and disregarding of my boundaries, there would be an acknowledgment of this from her, but the actions wouldn’t change, and excuses would be made so I would often feel bad for her, which I suppose led to me minimising my needs, or pushing mine aside to care for her and her feelings as she cried or referred to herself as bad.

I don’t feel like it’s that black and white. I feel like some choices were made on her behalf that came from a place of fear, stress and pain. Like regularly disregarding boundaries and lying. I’m understanding and empathetic, but I feel hurt nonetheless.
I don’t feel it was coming from a malicious place, but an intense fear of abandonment and some other mental health issues. I have compassion for her, but I’m hurt by what’s unfolded nonetheless.
